diary.t: COP31 GIVEN UNTIL 6AM FOR A DEAL

features.head: WALL STREET IN CORRECTION AS TECH CRASH DEEPENS
features.sum: Nasdaq fell 5.3 percent on Friday and the S and P 500 entered correction as the AI sell-off deepened; Bitcoin slid below $56,000 on Sunday.

features.head: TRUMP LANDS FOR APEC SUMMIT
features.sum: President Trump reaches Shenzhen for the APEC summit, with a trilateral meeting planned with Xi and Putin after their talks in the same city.

features.head: DENMARK EXPELS RUSSIAN ATTACHE OVER PLOT
features.sum: Denmark expels Russia's defence attache over suspicion Moscow plotted to kill a US-Ukrainian rapper, and pushes the EU to tighten curbs on Russians.

features.head: ESTONIA TO SHUT BORDER WITH RUSSIA
features.sum: Estonia says it will close its border with Russia, and Moscow denounces the move as a new Iron Curtain across Europe.

features.head: QATAR: CIVILIAN KILLED BY SHRAPNEL
features.sum: Qatar says a civilian was killed and another hurt by shrapnel from military operations in the area after a vessel failed to return on Saturday.

features.head: KINGPIN HELD, SINALOA BURNS
features.sum: Mexico holds FBI most-wanted Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, 'El Chapo Isidro', in a Friday-night raid; 11 are killed as cartel gunmen hit back across Sinaloa.

features.head: SA COALITION DEALS DUE AS ANC SLUMPS TO 31%
features.sum: Two weeks after the ANC's worst-ever 30.8 percent local result, councils must settle mayors by about 22 November; hung councils have nearly doubled to around 135.

features.head: KYIV HIT AS RUSSIA FIRES 400 DRONES
features.sum: Russia fires 400 drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine in one barrage; Kyiv's bridges are hit and Zelensky says strikes on Russian bridges are fair game.

features.head: NIGERIA BOAT CAPSIZE KILLS 24
features.sum: A boat carrying mourners to a funeral capsizes in Nigeria; emergency officials report 24 bodies recovered.

leads.head: GULF ON ALERT AS IRAN WAR GRINDS ON
leads.sum: Bahrain blames Iran for a fire at an industrial plant and Hormuz shipping takes two more strikes, days after Tehran's drones hit US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. Qatar mediates as the talks stall.

leads.head: COP31 IN OVERTIME AS DEAL SLIPS AWAY
leads.sum: Talks drag into a second day of overtime on Sunday with no final text. The draft drops every mention of fossil fuels, and the Antalya Accords admit for the first time that 1.5C has been missed.

leads.head: PERU COUNTS 152 HOMES LOST TO M6.7 QUAKE
leads.sum: USGS revises the week's big Andes quake down to M6.7. A revised count on Sunday lists 152 homes uninhabitable near Junin, with no deaths reported and aftershocks still being checked.
